entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For returns or exchanges, press 1. For technical support, press 2. For all other inquiries, please stay on the line.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return something. Order number is VF77209. Just tell me yes or no, can I return it?

I can certainly look into that for you. One moment while I pull up that order... Okay, I see the Men's Pro Aero Jersey. To make sure I get you the right solution, what specifically is the issue with it?
It's the wrong size. The jersey is way too tight. I just want to know if I can get an exchange or a refund.
Understood. Thank you for clarifying. I see here it was delivered 69 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return window for standard apparel. So yes, we can absolutely process that for you.
Good. I want to exchange it for a large.

Not a problem at all. I can get that exchange started right away. And since you're a VIP member with VeloFit, I've gone ahead and upgraded the shipping on the new size to complimentary overnight service. I'm also sending the pre-paid return label for the medium jersey to your email now.
Overnight? Okay, that's actually helpful. Thanks.
Of course. You'll just need to send back the jersey that was too tight within 14 days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for your call and for being a loyal VeloFit customer. Have a wonderful day.
